newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia licenses IB Austria brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Croatia licenses IB Austria brokerage.

text.p: Croatia's securities market watchdog said on Tuesday it had issued a stockbroking licence to the Croatian arm of Investmentbank Austria.

"This is the second foreign brokerage we have registered, but two-three local firms have also applied for the licence," Ante Gasparevic of the Croatian Securities Commission told Reuters by telephone.
Austria's Creditanstalt Investment Bank unit in Croatia was allowed to open a local brokerage last month under regulations passed early in 1996.
Most of the country's almost 60 market consultancies and brokerages opened before stricter rules were enforced.
Of these, 45 are members of the Zagreb Stock Exchange and the rest only trade on an over-the-counter (OTC) market in Varazdin.
